cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I reassure you about the wedding, say exactly what I'm guaranteeing. I taught you to ask for something specific, not just look frightened at me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A complete sentence; that's progress. Weather, marriage or catering? Tick one so I can send it for the right approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Much more specific. I'll amend the request: one-time comfort or reassurance throughout the ceremony? Put the duration in before I approve it.

reason: Use the actual distinctive Drive with a particular former-pupil habit. Keep vocabulary corrections informative, restrictions warmly delivered, and B practical concerns responsible for A next choice.
